profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & Cloud Architect | AWS GovCloud | Python, DevSecOps, AI/LLM & Geospatial Data Platforms | MS Data Science | Defense & Aerospace
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Software Engineer and full-stack systems architect with more than 15 years of experience delivering secure, mission-focused technology across the defense, intelligence, aerospace, and government sectors.

My work spans the complete engineering lifecycle, from cloud and application architecture through software development, DevSecOps, security, deployment, and operational support. I specialize in building secure Python platforms, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud-native systems that support geospatial analytics, data science, and LLM-enabled applications.

In my current role, I own the architecture and delivery of an end-to-end application and DevSecOps platform hosted in AWS GovCloud. I recently designed and delivered a production-ready Python backend in two weeks to meet an urgent customer requirement. The platform includes RESTful APIs, a Model Context Protocol server, a reusable Python client module, and integrations with Amazon Aurora, Cognito, OpenSearch, S3, and EC2.

I also transformed the organization’s software delivery process by implementing secure CI/CD automation that reduced deployments from several hours to approximately 10 minutes. The pipeline incorporates vulnerability scanning, dependency and container-image analysis, container hardening, automated testing, access controls, and deployment validation.

My broader technical background includes:

• Python and C/C++ systems development
• RESTful APIs, microservices, MCP servers, and reusable SDKs
• AWS GovCloud architecture and cloud security
• Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevSecOps
• Data ingestion, transformation, GeoJSON, and geospatial systems
• LLM applications, AI/ML, predictive modeling, and search platforms
• Linux, networking, enterprise infrastructure, and mission operations

Before moving fully into software engineering, I led enterprise infrastructure and mission-system operations supporting more than 10,000 users. I am also a U.S. Air Force veteran with extensive experience leading multidisciplinary technical and intelligence teams in operational environments.

I hold a Master of Science in Data Analytics with a specialization in Data Science. I bring together software engineering, cloud architecture, cybersecurity, data engineering, and operational leadership to build systems that are secure, maintainable, and capable of supporting real-world mission requirements.

Core technologies: Python, C, C++, SQL, AWS GovCloud, Aurora PostgreSQL, Cognito, OpenSearch, S3, EC2, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, REST APIs, MCP, GeoJSON, Linux, React, and Azure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I own the architecture, development, security, deployment, and operational reliability of an end-to-end DevSecOps and Python application platform hosted in AWS GovCloud and supporting geospatial, LLM, and data science workflows.

I architected and delivered a production-ready Python backend in two weeks to meet an urgent customer requirement. The platform includes RESTful APIs, a Model Context Protocol server, and a reusable Python module for end-user data science workflows.

I designed the AWS GovCloud architecture using Aurora for relational data persistence, Amazon Cognito for authentication and access control, OpenSearch for search and retrieval, Amazon S3 for object storage, and EC2 for application hosting and compute.

I develop Python-based ingestion and processing workflows that retrieve, validate, normalize, and transform external vendor data, including GeoJSON and other structured formats, for use in geospatial analytics and LLM-enabled applications.

I transformed the organization’s software delivery process by architecting a secure, automated CI/CD platform that reduced deployment times from several hours to approximately 10 minutes while incorporating automated vulnerability scanning, dependency and container image scanning, and container hardening.

I also established standardized DevSecOps controls across build and release workflows, including access control, security validation, hardened container configurations, deployment automation, logging, and operational monitoring. These improvements increased release reliability, reduced manual engineering effort, and accelerated delivery of new data sources and customer capabilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
As a systems programming software engineer, I have extensive experience in Python and Agile methodologies. My responsibilities include developing Python code that leverages C libraries using ctypes, maintaining and extending cross-platform, low-level network protocols in both C and Python, and creating and maintaining microservices. I am also involved in researching and implementing new systems technologies such as containers and cloud computing. I ensure that all code meets industry-standard design practices through implementation and refactoring as needed. Adhering to engineering processes, I ensure the robustness, testability, and proper design of code, documenting all written code, requirements, and user documentation. I guarantee application reliability through automated unit and integration tests using frameworks like Python unittest, pyTest, and Google Test. Additionally, I provide software support to customers and partners.

My experience extends to building front-end web applications that interact with backend services using technologies such as React, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, and the Python WSGI interface. I have deployed applications to both Azure and AWS. Beyond development, I manage DevOps for multiple Parsons COTS products and apply my systems engineering skills to improve processes and support development.

positions.title: Information Technology Engineer
positions.description: Architected the engineering support infrastructure, managing the deployment and scaling of enterprise-grade tools including JFrog Artifactory, Bitbucket, and Jenkins for 50+ engineers. Implemented a centralized asset management system (Datto), enabling unified control of corporate computer assets and hardware lifecycle tracking. Modernized the enterprise backup stack, engineered for high data availability and disaster recovery across the corporate network. Directed technical operations and maintenance, planning scheduled outages, monitoring multi-disciplinary workflows, and providing technical mentorship to junior engineering staff.

positions.title: GS-2210-12 - Lead Information Technology Specialist (Operating Systems)
positions.description: The work of this position involves the analytical planning, design, installation, configuration, integration, testing, evaluation, implementation, and management of the systems NIPR and SIPR net environments in support of the Information Technology (IT) systems engineering technologies and business needs for the Western Region Network Enterprise Center (RNEC) and for the various Local Network Enterprise Centers (LNECs) within its geographic area of responsibility (AOR). Serves as a senior specialist and focal point for the installation's IT operating systems. Develops and recommends technical solutions prior to acquisition efforts. Serves as the Server Administration Team Lead, responsible for personnel within team. Evaluates new, large systems engineering technology and its effects on a complex operating environment.

positions.title: GS-2210-11 Information Technology Specialist
positions.description: Installs NAS/SAN and UNIX based software and equipment. Maintains procedures for NAS/SAN and Linux hardware product assembly and installation. Monitors operation of the NAS/SAN and Linux environments and ensures that hardware and software are functioning properly and that operation standards are met. Provides guidance on technical aspects of NAS/SAN and Linux equipment. Install, maintain, and monitor fiber switches, the physical connections, and the configuration settings for the fiber environment. Responds to users' requests for assistance in a timely manner. Identifies and determines problems and the corrective action to be taken in case of hardware/software failure or in circumstances when prescribed procedures will not produce  desired results. Coordinates support actions with user, management, contractor personnel, and higher levels as required. Troubleshoots all aspects of the system to include hardware, software, and communications lines. Maintains a continuing awareness of technical changes in the areas of equipment technology and software development.

positions.title: Information Technology Lead
positions.description: Directed a 7-member Server Administration Team managing 12 physical servers and 200+ VMware virtual machines, ensuring 99.9% uptime for critical NIPR/SIPR mission networks. Expanded infrastructure storage capacity by 50% by engineering a centralized NAS/SAN solution and SMB shares, supporting the virtualization needs of 10,000+ regional users. Orchestrated emergency recovery operations during a major SIPRnet SharePoint outage; led the diagnosis and repair of a catastrophic MSSQL failure to restore services for 10,000+ users. Spearheaded technical procurement and vendor relations; evaluated, priced, and purchased critical software/hardware assets, ensuring all acquisitions met rigorous technical standards and budgetary constraints.

positions.title: Network Engineer II
positions.description:
DoD Cleared professional. 

Oversees network management and monitoring operations of the C2BMC network communications infrastructure and associated interfaces to the Ballistic Missile Defense Communications Network (BMD COMNET). Monitors network management software, generating ad hoc queries for network assistance, and directing courses of action. Sustains a watch on network performance characteristics and infrastructure centers of gravity, and recommend adjustments. Centrally monitors and controls network infrastructure, available bandwidth, hardware and server devices, and performs network configuration changes, characterization and optimization to ensure efficient use. Analyzes logs and responds to detected network anomalies, faults (errors), other incidents and user reported outages - Follow established procedures to respond to events and makes necessary repairs and adjustments/configuration changes - Escalates as required for assistance in isolating the fault and making repairs as necessary. Interfaces directly with the C2BMC Watch Officer (CWO), Network Defender, System Administrators and customers to provide on-going trouble status and/or to accept customer trouble claims. Knowledge of hardware (Routers, CSU/DSU, bridges, multiplexers, servers and switches configuration). Knowledge of Cisco network communications components (routers, switches, etc.) and their operations. Knowledge of Juniper network communications components (routers, switches, etc.) and their operations. Knowledge of how to configure and manage Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANS) and IPSec gateways.

positions.title: Field Engineer
positions.description: Maintained 99.9% mission availability for the C2BMC and GMD network infrastructures, overseeing Cisco and Juniper nodes in support of national ballistic missile defense. Achieved zero downtime during primary network outages by configuring and managing redundant failover protocols using OSPF and Multicast. Reduced Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) to under 1 hour for hardware/software anomalies; personally executed a 3-hour emergency switch replacement to restore critical network connectivity.

positions.title: Field Engineer II
positions.description:
DoD Cleared professional. 

Responsible for daily operational and maintenance activities of GFC/C IFICS Data Terminal (IDT), Communications Node Equipment (CNE), Network System Manager (NSM) and Long Haul Communications (LHC) equipment in support of the GMD Missile Defense Mission at Ft. Greely, Alaska. Conducts technical analysis of product implementations, modifications and enhancements to product in accordance with specific customer specifications and implementations. Responsible for operating, troubleshooting, problem reporting / resolution, replacement of LRU (Line Replaceable Unit), property tracking and trouble ticket resolution. Complete preventative maintenance as scheduled and react appropriately to corrective maintenance actions. Effectively communicates with a variety of military and government customers. I am very familiar and comfortable with the Command Line Interface in the Sun Solaris operating system. Experienced with setting up, troubleshooting, and monitoring OSPF and Multicast routing protocols as well as Cisco Routers, Cisco Switches, and Cisco Firewalls through Cisco IOS. Uses HP OpenView to monitor and troubleshoot network connectivity. Keys, operates, and configures KIV-19A and KIV-19M cryptographic equipment; also maintains COMSEC and SKL devices. Other equipment I maintain and operate include, 3 IPS devices, 10 CSU/DSU’s, 4 Sun Fire 800 series servers, 3 Sun Blade 2500 workstations, and 3 Sun Netra 240 Servers.

positions.title: Network Systems Manager/Long Haul Comm Systems Manager
positions.description:
DoD Cleared professional. 

Responsible for monitoring both local and wide area classified/unclassified networks using HP Openview applications and Cisco logs. Identify, isolate hardware problems and perform router and switch port configurations using Cisco IOS as well as the execution of intelligent protection switches (IPSs) in accordance with prescribed documentation. Interface with customers to provide Level 1 Problem Resolution, determine hardware/software interface anomalies, generate trouble reports using Remedy IT Service Management Software and perform recovery actions as directed by governing regulations. Archive related information, to include database records and provide to Resident Engineers, programmers, and product support personnel. Effectively communicate with a variety of military and government customers.

positions.title: Staff Sergeant - Supervisor
positions.description:
Evaluated and trained over 30 diverse personnel throughout 8-year military career, 6 of which were spent as a Supervisor. Developed and initiated training requirements to meet individual needs; provided hands-on training teaching new personnel their duties as well as meeting workplace standards. Wrote and maintained occupational reference materials in order to provide direction and
continuity to staff. Tracked training on all personnel ensuring all personnel stay qualified for tasks. Mentored subordinates to set and meet goals; encouraged open communication regardless of issues. Investigated discipline issues determined cause and disciplined accordingly either verbally or written.
Upheld standards of diversity among my subordinates; counseled subordinates on infractions and set proper example for them to follow. Managed work schedule for a team of 8 in order to ensure coverage during normal scheduled work hours as well as contingency operations. 

Program Management
Managed Squadron’s Operations Security program tracked over 173 diverse personnel’s training; provided security training and randomized inspections in order to ensure that procedures were followed and that all members of the team were able to conduct operations safely. Aircrew Intelligence Training manager for 173 aircrew personnel ensured all staff were kept apprised of
evolving enemy threat systems and tactics. Created and managed Geospatial program that supported 4 different organizations and created the standard automated system now used by all of those organizations. Managed Electronic Intelligence Program for 5 different organizations and 6 different types of Aircraft which ensured the successful generation and dissemination of over 5,000 reports encompassing over 1,000 different radar sites on a weekly basis.

positions.title: Electronic Signals Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
Department supervisor managed a team of 14 diverse staff members. Oversaw collection, and dissemination of complex and technical Electronic Intelligence data, provided military leaders and personnel in combat zones up to date information. Formally briefed daily intelligence reports to General Officers and other key personnel associated with multiple government organizations during
Alaska North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD) operations in order to ensure U.S. air sovereignty in the North. Provided Electronic Intelligence related analytical products to 6 aircrew that were used in conjunction with the E-3 AWACs flight plan in order to minimize threat risk during high risk flying missions. Compiled and briefed 42 daily intelligence briefs for the Air Operations Center in order to keep over 200 Airmen informed on current theater events.

IT Experience
Experienced in advanced management of the Solaris 10 OS including OS set up and configuration, patch managements, software upgrades, hardware upgrades/replacement, and security hardening and auditing. Other Operating Systems I am familiar with include Ubuntu (an open source, Linux based OS), OS X 10.6 Snow Leopard, OS X 10.7 Lion, and OS X 10.8 Mountain Lion. I have 6 years of experience of dealing with Communications Security (COMSEC) materials and equipment, specifically for KIV-7, KG-96, KG-94, Protocol Processing Unit (PPU), and the AN/CYZ-10 DTD. Spent 3 years as a COMSEC manager responsible for personnel training, periodic key changes, and key issuance/storage/destruction following the regulations set by the National Security Agency. Operated specialized tactical computer terminals and equipment associated with the U.S. Air Force Enhanced Tactical Data processing Suite and it's follow on, the Tactical Data Processing Suite-Lite. Maintained and upgraded 11 UNIX based computer systems that ran mission critical military intelligence analytical software used by my team, reducing system down time by 40%.

positions.title: Staff Sergeant
positions.description: Standardized an automated Geospatial (GEOINT) reporting system across 4 organizations, replacing manual tracking and consolidating over 5,000 weekly intelligence reports into a unified operational view. Increased actionable intelligence production by 70% by streamlining communication between 6 Federal agencies and frontline Battle Space Operators in theater. Led a 14-member multi-disciplinary team in Afghanistan, managing 51 mission-critical systems and analyzing 23,000+ intelligence reports.

positions.title: Human Intelligence Analyst - Afghanistan
positions.description:
DOD Cleared Professional.

Floor manager of the Human Intelligence Analysis Cell in charge of 9 diverse staff members and managed 51 computer systems. Provided Human Intelligence Analytical support directly to over a dozen tactical and theater level Commanders in order to ensure the safety and bolster the combat effectiveness of front line combat units. Effectively analyzed over 23,000 Intelligence Information reports. Created and initiated the process of combined foreign and U.S. intelligence reports, increased information output by 30%. Solely responsible for delivering theater-wide Human Intelligence reporting to previously unreached units throughout Afghanistan; received personal recognition from the Joint Forces Commander. At the Detention Facility in Parwan, Afghanistan, I personally assessed incoming detainees for intelligence value and managed the creation of the initial intelligence packets that were used to effectively focus intelligence collection during interrogation operations. I used my expertise to stand up an entirely new intelligence section by writing the reference materials that became the standard for training my diverse team of analyst in core job tasks. Hand-picked by the Theater Intelligence Group Commander to be the Improvised Explosive Device (IED) subject matter expert. I conducted research and determined root causes, thus creating guidance used by U.S troops in theater, which ensured the safety of our military personnel in the field. Established direct lines of communication with 6 Federals agencies and military organizations in order to streamline the dissemination of intelligence information which resulted in a 70% increase in valuable intelligence production. and increased the value and timeliness of intelligence that was passed to the Battle Space Operators throughout the theater.
